Terms of Service

An open-source planner, with clear expectations about downloads, backups and support.

Prepared 26 October 2026 · Publisher: Hussam Alkhatib, Todorbit.

1. Software license

Todorbit is provided under the MIT license. That license governs use, copying, modification and distribution of the software. These informational service terms do not replace the MIT license or reduce the permissions it grants. Third-party components retain their respective licenses and notices in the source and distribution.

2. Pre-release software

The current Windows x64 download is a pre-release. Packages are unsigned. Review the release notes and published checksums before running a download. Windows 11 is the primary development and test platform; Windows 10 acceptance is limited. Features and supported formats may change between versions.

The software is provided as is, subject to the warranty disclaimer and liability provisions in the MIT license. No separate uptime, support-response or data-recovery guarantee is offered here.

3. Your records and backups

You control your local planner records and any backups you choose to create. Keep a verified recovery copy before upgrading, moving a portable folder or replacing a database. Check the source and target profiles before confirming a restore.

A full restore replaces local records; it does not merge edits across devices. A Before Restore snapshot is part of the recovery process, but you should independently verify important backups. Linked external file contents are not included in cloud database snapshots. Local files are not encrypted by Todorbit's interface PIN.

For encrypted cloud backups, keep the recovery passphrase separately. Todorbit does not retain it and cannot recover a backup without it.

4. Optional third-party services

Google Drive backup is being prepared for public access and is not generally available in the current public download. Connecting an account, once available, will require authorization through Google. Google account availability, storage quotas, administrative restrictions and Google's own terms can affect that service. Todorbit does not promise continuous synchronization or uninterrupted third-party access.

GitHub hosts the source and release downloads and may host this website. Use of third-party services is also subject to their applicable terms. See the Privacy Policy for data handling, deletion and disconnection behavior.

5. Support and security

Support is provided on a best-effort basis through GitHub issues or hussamalkhatib24@gmail.com. Please provide a version and reproduction steps using disposable data. Never post private databases, tokens, passwords or recovery passphrases in public reports. Send security concerns by email.

6. Updates to this information

These pages may be updated as functionality and service availability change. Review the version's release notes and the current privacy disclosure before using a new optional service. The license accompanying your software continues to apply.
